usage: placket accept [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory

usage: placket answer [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--keep  keep the signed call
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--no-release  ask for no release
--question string  the question's id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--text string  the answer (default accepted)

usage: placket bind [flags]
--actor string  the actor
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  the principal's key file
--mediator string  the mediator
--policy string  the founding set's policy
--role value  a role label
--until string  until

usage: placket cancel [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--question string  the question's id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory

usage: placket card [flags]
--default  this build's card
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--judge value  a judge's config, once per judge

usage: placket change [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--comment string  a comment
--file string  a file holding the version
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--keep  keep the version
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--no-release  ask for no release
--question string  the question's id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--text string  the version

usage: placket declare [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--terms string  terms file

usage: placket decline [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--comment string  the comment
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--question string  the question's id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory

usage: placket founding [flags]
--binding value  a binding
--card string  card
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--mediator string  mediator
--policy string  policy
--seal value  a declaration's seal entry

usage: placket get [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--all  fetch every delivery
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--keep  keep the part
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--out string  directory for the body
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--wait int  seconds to wait for a delivery, at most 60

usage: placket give [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--as string  text, raw or data (default text)
--file string  file
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--keep  keep the part
--key string  key file
--kind string  kind
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--re string  re
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--text string  text
--to string  receiver
--topic string  topic
--wait  wait for the answer

usage: placket init [flags]
--dir string  the directory to write in, empty or new
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--label string  the label
placket init approve [flags]
placket init merge [flags]
placket init handoff [flags]

usage: placket key [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object
placket key new [flags]
placket key ref [flags]

usage: placket log [flags]
--all  a row for every crossing
--format string  json or csv (default json)
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--kept value  a state directory
--mediator string  mediator
--no-words  empty the comments
--receipts string  journal directory
--words  add the texts

usage: placket mcp [flags]
--allow-answering  serve a label whose key answers questions too
--label value  a mediator of the labels config to serve, once per mediator

usage: placket mediators [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object

usage: placket questions [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--wait int  seconds to wait for a question, at most 60

usage: placket reconcile [flags]
--accord string  accord
--card string  card
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--kept value  a state directory
--mediator string  mediator
--receipts string  journal directory

usage: placket released [flags]
--at string  a JSON pointer into the body
--every  every match
--file string  the file
--from string  the receipt's sender
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--kind value  a kind the part may have
--re string  the part's re
--state string  state directory
--value string  the value, as text
--value-file string  the value's bytes

usage: placket result [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--question string  the question's id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory
--wait int  seconds to wait for the closing, at most 60

usage: placket seal [flags]
--declaration string  the signed declaration
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--out string  the directory the opening is written to (default .)

usage: placket show [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--receipt string  a file holding one receipt

usage: placket verify [flags]
--acceptances string  the founding set's acceptances, acceptances.json beside it when not given
--accord string  the Accord id
--answers string  a file of answer calls, one a line
--delivery string  a delivery, as get --json saved it
--founding string  the founding set
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--mediator string  the mediator
--open value  a member's opening, once per opening, for a dispute
--receipts string  journal directory
--subset  the receipts are a subset
--superseded-by string  the founding set of the Accord that supersedes this one
--view string  a member's own view, as it kept it, to check its receipts against

usage: placket version [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object

usage: placket view [flags]
--accord string  the Accord id
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  key file
--label string  a mediator of the labels config, by its label or Accord id
--socket string  the window's socket
--state string  state directory

usage: placket watch [flags]
--count int  exit once this many questions are printed
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--label value  a mediator of the labels config to watch, once per mediator

usage: placket window [flags]
--acceptances string  acceptances.json
--founding string  the founding set
--journal string  journal directory
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--judge value  a judge's config, once per judge the card lists
--key string  the mediator's key file
--openings string  the directory of every member's opening
--socket string  socket
placket window close [flags]

usage: placket key new [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--out string  the key file to write

usage: placket key ref [flags]
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  the key file

usage: placket window close [flags]
--acceptances string  acceptances.json
--accord string  the Accord id, the founding set's
--founding string  the founding set
--journal string  journal directory
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--key string  the mediator's key file
--openings string  the directory of every member's opening
--socket string  socket

usage: placket init approve [flags]
--dir string  the directory to write in, empty or new
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--label string  the label (default approve)

usage: placket init merge [flags]
--dir string  the directory to write in, empty or new
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--label string  the label (default merge)

usage: placket init handoff [flags]
--dir string  the directory to write in, empty or new
--json  print the result as one JSON object
--label string  the label (default handoff)
